children: Hugh H Mclean, a Director, reported a direct sale of 25,000 shares at $25.727 per share for a total of $643,175 and noted he moved 3,077 shares from an Old Second Bancorp-held account to his brokerage account; following the transaction he directly owns 135,351 shares and holds 10,595 restricted stock units.

Darin Patrick Campbell, a Director and President, Powersports Lending, reported sales totaling 24,000 shares at a weighted average selling price of $25.533 per share (range $25.50–$25.60) for a total of $612,792; after the transactions he directly owns 250,589 shares and holds 10,562 restricted shares.
